senses.gloss:
ध्वंस् ध्वंस् (sometimes written ध्वस्),
cl. 1. A. ध्वंसते (ep. also -ति), द-
ध्वंसे, ध्वंसिष्यते, अध्वंसिष्ट, अध्वसत्,
ध्वंसितुम्, to fall down, fall to pieces, fall to dust,
be reduced to powder, decay, to be ruined; perish;
to become eclipsed; to scatter or sprinkle over, cover
with; to be covered or sprinkled with dust; (the
imperative ध्वंस, ध्वंसत, = ‘be gone,’ ‘away
with you,’ ‘vanish’): Pass. ध्वस्यते, to be destroyed,
perish, &c.: Caus. ध्वंसयति, to cause to fall,
fell, throw down, cause to perish, destroy; to inter-
rupt; ध्वसयति, &c., Ved. to scatter, disperse
(darkness &c.): Desid. दिध्वंसिषते: Intens. द-
नीध्वस्यते and दनीध्वंस्ति, दनीध्वंसीति;
[cf. Goth. drus, ‘to fall;’ drausya = ‘I fall,’ = Caus.
ध्वंसयामि: Old Germ. troryu, ‘I gush.’]

ध्वंसक, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of a comp.),
destroying, causing to fall or perish, removing.

ध्वंसनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, liable to destruction,
capable of being ruined.

ध्वंसयित्वा, ind. having destroyed; having
interrupted.
ध्वंसि, इस्, m. (1/100) part of a Muhūrta.

ध्वंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to fall, destroyed,
demolished, ruined, lost.

ध्वंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling, perishing, being
destroyed, decaying; causing to fall, destroying,
destructive; (ई), m. a Pīlu tree (said to grow in
mountainous districts).

ध्वज् 1. ध्वज् or ध्वञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. ध्वजति,
ध्वञ्जति, &c., to go, move; [cf. perhaps
Lat. vagus, vagari.]

2. ध्वज् = ध्वज in कृत-ध्˚, Ṛg-veda VII.
83, 2.

ध्वज, अस्, rarely अम्, n. (connected with rt.
1. ध्वज् and perhaps with rt. 1. धू), a banner,
standard, flag-staff, flag, ensign, pennon; (meta-
phorically) a distinguished or eminent personage
(e. g. कुल-ध्वज, the head or ornament of a
family); a mark, emblem, sign, symbol, character-
istic mark [cf. कज्जल-ध्˚, धर्म-ध्˚, धूम-
ध्˚, धूलि-ध्˚, वृषभ-ध्˚, &c.]; the attribute
of a deity; the sign of any trade; the sign of
a distillery or of a tavern [cf. सुरा-ध्˚]; the
business there carried on; the penis &c., the organ
of generation (of any animal, male or female); a
skull carried on a staff as a mark of ascetics and
Yogis; a house situated to the east of any object;
a place prepared in a peculiar way for building; (in
prosody) an iambic; (in Vedic grammar) N. of a
peculiar kind of Krama-pāṭha; (in astronomy) N.
of a Yoga; N. of a Grāma situated towards the
north; (अस्), m. one who prepares or sells spirituous
liquors; (according to some) pride, hypocrisy.
—ध्वज-गृह, अम्, n. a room in which banners
are kept or from which flags wave.
—ध्वज-ग्रीव,
अस्, m. ‘having a neck erect as a banner,’ N. of a
Rakṣas.
—ध्वज-द्रुम, अस्, m. the palm tree
(used for making flag-staffs, = ताल).
—ध्वज-न-
वमी, f., N. of a particular festival.
—ध्वज-पट,
अस्, m. ‘banner-cloth,’ the cloth of the flag, a flag.
—ध्वज-प्रहरण, अस्, m. ‘striking banners or
flags,’ air, wind, gale.
—ध्वज-भङ्ग or ध्वज-
पात, अस्, m. ‘fall or impotence of the male organ,’
inability to procreate children; fracture or fall of a
banner.
—ध्वज-यन्त्र, अम्, n. ‘banner-instru-
ment,’ any contrivance to which a flag-staff is fastened.
—ध्वज-यष्टि, इस्, f. a flag-staff.
—ध्वज-राजिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, displaying flags or ensigns.
—ध्वज-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, decorated or adorned with flags; having
a mark or sign, bearing the mark of a criminal,
branded; (आन्), m. an ensign, a standard-bearer; a
distiller, a vendor of spirituous liquors; a Brāhman
who having slain another carries the skull of the
murdered man with him to places of pilgrimage by
way of penance; (अती), f., N. of a divine female;
N. of a divine attendant of a Bodhi-sattva.
—ध्वज-
स्तम्भ, अस्, m. a flag-staff.
—ध्वजांशुक (˚ज-
अं˚), अम्, n. ‘banner-cloth,’ a flag.
—ध्वजाग्र-
केयूर (˚ज-अग्˚), अम्, n. ‘the ring on the top of a
standard,’ N. of a kind of abstract contemplation
(among Buddhists).
—ध्वजाग्र-निशा-मणि (˚ज-
अग्˚), इस्, m. ‘the moon (night-jewel) of the standard-
top,’ N. for a peculiar method of numeration.
—ध्वजाग्र-वती (˚ज-अग्˚), f. ‘furnished with a
standard-top,’ N. for a mode of reckoning.
—ध्व-
जारोह, probably a wrong reading for गजारोह,
q. v.
—ध्वजाहृत (˚ज-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, robbed
or taken possession of at the standard, i. e. on the
battle-field.
—ध्वजी-करण, अम्, n. raising a
standard, hoisting a flag; making anything a plea,
setting up as a claim or right.
—ध्वजी-कृ, cl. 8.
P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to set up a standard,
hoist a flag; to use as a mark, sign, or pretext.
—ध्वजी-कृत्य, ind. having raised a standard;
having made a plea or pretext.
—ध्वजोच्छ्राय
(˚ज-उच्˚), अस्, m. erecting a banner; erection of the
male organ.
—ध्वजोत्थान (˚ज-उत्˚), अम्, n.
‘erection of a flag,’ a festival in honour of Indra,
the twelfth day of the light half of the month
Bhādra.

ध्वजिक in धर्म-ध्वजिक, a hypocrite who
only makes a pretence of religion; [cf. धर्म-
ध्वज.]
ध्वञ्ज् ध्वञ्ज्. See rt. 1. ध्वज्, col. 1.

ध्वण् ध्वण् (connected with rt. 2. ध्वन्),
cl. 1. P. ध्वणति, &c., to sound.

ध्वन् 1. ध्वन् (related to rt. ध्वंस्),
Ved. to become covered or shut up, cover
one's self, &c.: Caus. ध्वनयति, -यितुम्, to en-
velope, wrap up.

ध्वन् 2. ध्वन् (connected with rts. ध्वण्
and ध्रण्), cl. 1. P. ध्वनति, द-
ध्वान, ध्वनितुम्, to sound, produce a sound,
utter sounds, buzz, roar, echo, reverberate: Caus. P.
ध्वनयति and ध्वानयति, &c., to sound, cause
to sound; [cf. Goth. drun-yu-s, ‘sound;’ Angl.
Sax. dyn-an, dyne.]

2. ध्वन्; add — Pass. ध्वन्यते, to be implied
or signified.

1. ध्वान्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see under 2. ध्वन्
below), covered, enveloped, dark; (अम्), n. darkness,
night.
—ध्वान्त-चित्त, अस्, m. ‘perceived in the
dark (?),’ a fire-fly; (also read ध्वान्त-वित्त.)
—ध्वान्-
त-जाल, अम्, n. ‘the net of darkness or the cover of
night,’ a veil (?).
—ध्वान्त-शात्रव, अस्, m. ‘enemy
of darkness,’ N. of the tree Cassia Fistula; the sun
or any luminary.
—ध्वान्ताराति (˚त-अर्˚), इस्, m.
‘enemy of darkness,’ the sun or any luminary.
—ध्वान्तोन्मेष (˚त-उन्˚), अस्, m. ‘flashing or
twinkling in the darkness,’ a fire-fly.

2. ध्वान्त, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a wind. (For 1.
ध्वान्त see under 1. ध्वन् above.)

ध्वान्त ध्वान्त. For 1. and 2. ध्वान्त
see p. 462, col. 3.

ध्वन, अस्, m., N. of a wind; sound, tune; N.
of a man.
—ध्वन-मोदिन्, ई, m. ‘delighting by its
sound,’ the humble-bee.

ध्वान, अस्, m. humming, murmuring, one of the
seven kinds of speech or वाचः स्थानानि, (a degree
louder than उपांशु, q. v.); sound or tone in general.
ध्वनत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding, making a noise.
ध्वनन, अम्, n. sounding; hinting at.

ध्वनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to sound or
resound, resounding, echoing with; (अन्), m., N. of
a wind.

ध्वनि, इस्, m. sound, echo, noise; tone, tune;
thunder; the sound of a drum; an inarticulate sound,
a mere empty sound without reality; a word; allu-
sion, hint, figurative allusion, implied meaning,
poetical style; N. of a work.
—ध्वनि-कार, अस्,
or ध्वनि-कृत्, त्, m. the author of the work called
Dhvani.
—ध्वनि-ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘apprehending
sounds,’ the ear; hearing.
—ध्वनि-त्व, अम्, n.
figurative allusion, poetical style.
—ध्वनि-नाथ,
अस्, m., N. of a man.
—ध्वनि-नाला, f., N. of
several musical instruments, = काहला, a sort of
trumpet; the Vīṇā or lute; a pipe, fife.
—ध्वनि-
बोधक or ध्वनि-बोधन, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
N. of the grass Rohisha.
—ध्वनि-विकार, अस्, m.
a change of voice (caused by fright or grief, &c.).
—ध्वन्य्-अर्थ, अस्, m. the meaning or truth
implied.

ध्वनित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, making a noise
(as a drum); alluded to, implied, figuratively or
rhetorically expressed; (अम्), n. sound, thunder.

ध्वानित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to sound, made
resonant.
ध्वन्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
ध्वस् ध्वस्. See rt. ध्वंस्, col. 1.

ध्वस्, ध्वत् (fr. rt. ध्वंस्), (at the end of
certain comps.) causing to fall, throwing down.
ध्वसन्, आ, m., Ved., N. of a king of the Matsyas.

ध्वसनि, इस्, m., Ved. the sprinkler; sprinkling,
scattering (as a cloud).
ध्वसन्ति, इस्, m., N. of a man.

ध्वसिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sprinkled, spattered,
covered; (Sāy.) destroyed; [cf. धूसर.]

ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen; destroyed, perished,
hurt, lost; covered, eclipsed, disappeared.
—ध्वस्-
ताक्ष (˚त-अक्ष), अस्, ई, अम्, having the eyes
sunk (as in death).

ध्वस्ति, इस्, f. ceasing, destruction, cessation (of
all the consequences of actions), one of the four states
to which the Yogin attains.

ध्वाक्षा ध्वाक्षा, f., N. of a plant and its
fruit.

ध्वाङ्क्ष् ध्वाङ्क्ष् [cf. rts. ध्माङ्क्ष् and
ध्राङ्क्ष्], cl. 1. P. ध्वाङ्क्षति,
&c., to utter the cry of birds, to caw, croak, crow,
&c.; to desire.

ध्वाङ्क्ष, अस्, m. a crow; (according to some)
any aquatic bird, as a crane, gull, &c., feeding on fish,
= Ardea Nivea; (sometimes used at the end of a
comp. to express contempt, e. g. तीर्थ-ध्वाङ्क्ष,
a crow at a sacred bathing-place, i. e. a man in the
wrong place); a beggar (on account of his insatia-
bleness); an impudent fellow; N. of one of the Nāgas
(= तक्षक); a house?; (in astronomy) N. of
a Yoga; (ई), f. a kind of plant, = काकोली, कक्को-
लिका, लघु-कावऌई; [cf. Hib. duis, ‘a crow.’]
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-जङ्घा, f., N. of a plant, = काक-
जङ्घा.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-जम्बू, ऊस्, f. = काक-जम्बू.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-तुण्ड-फल, a kind of plant the
fruit of which resembles the beak of a crow, (com-
monly called Thora-śvetakāvaḷī.)
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-
तुण्डा, ई, f. = ध्वाङ्क्ष-तुण्ड-फल; (ई), f. =
काक-नासा.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-दन्ती or ध्वाङ्क्ष-
नखी, f. = काक-तुण्डी.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-नामन्, आ
or अ, m. or n. (?), a dark species of Uḍumbara;
(नाम्नी), f. = काकोदुम्बरिका.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-ना-
शिनी, f. = हपुषा (?).
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-नासा, f. and
ध्वाङ्क्ष-नासिका, f. = काक-नासा.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-
पुष्ट, अस्, m. the Kokila or Indian cuckoo, =
काक-पुष्ट.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-माची, f. = काक-माची,
= लघु-कावऌई.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-राविन्, ई, इणी, इ,
cawing like a crow, having a voice like a crow.
—ध्वाङ्क्ष-वल्ली, f. = काक-नासा, = ध्वाङ्क्ष-
दन्ती, = करञ्ज.
—ध्वाङ्क्षादनी (˚ष-अद्˚),
f. = ध्वाङ्क्ष-दन्ती.
—ध्वाङ्क्षाराति (˚ष-
अर्˚), इस्, m. ‘enemy of crows,’ an owl.
ध्वाङ्क्षिका, f. = काकोली.

ध्वाङ्क्षोलिका or ध्वाङ्क्षोली, f. a medicinal
plant, = काकोली.

ध्वरस्, आस्, m. f., Ved. ‘destructive, hurtful,
injurious,’ N. of certain female demons or noxious
beings.
ध्वर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bent, made crooked, &c.
